title: AI Knowledge Ledger / Candidate Record
description: Executed contract for records under ledger/ and inbox/candidates/. Runtime gate: scripts/kb.py event_validation_errors (capture refuses records that violate the required set). Repository gate: tests/test_record_schema.py validates every committed record against this file, so schema and reality cannot drift silently. Update the schema, the validator and the test together. Records under resources/ are canonical current-view projections derived from these events and are intentionally out of scope.

kind.description: Open classification. Sensitivity never depends on this free-form label: every record containing a value field is redacted by default and active source-backed value records are materialized for exact retrieval.

source.description: Provenance reference such as thread:<id>/message:<n>, a file path, or a user statement descriptor. This is a string in every committed record; the pre-2026-07 draft that required an object was never implemented.
